plan_name: Hospital Appointment Booking System MVP Plan

tasks.title: Design PostgreSQL schema (users, roles, doctors, departments, availability, appointments with unique slot constraint, notifications, audit log) and migrations
Create design system and UI kit in React (teal theme, Inter typography, buttons, inputs, cards, chips, tabs, modals, bottom navigation, WCAG 2.1 AA basics)
Set up Node.js REST API project, environment config, TLS, role-based access middleware and audit logging
Implement registration, email verification, login (JWT, bcrypt) and password reset API
Build Welcome and Sign In screen with register, verify email modal and reset password sheet
Implement doctor search API (name, specialty, department filters, open-slot filtering) and doctor availability API with weekly schedule slot generation
Build Find a Doctor screen (search, specialty chips, doctor cards, empty state, next appointment card)
Implement booking, reschedule and cancel API with transactional conflict prevention and 24-hour cancellation rule
Build Doctor Profile and Booking screen (date selector, slot grid, summary, confirm, conflict toast) and My Appointments screen (tabs, reschedule, cancel modal)
Integrate SMTP email and Twilio SMS with queue worker for booking confirmations, 24-hour reminders, retries and delivery status tracking
Build Notifications screen (inbox, channel preferences, receptionist delivery status log with resend)
Implement admin APIs: add/edit/deactivate doctors, departments, schedules, appointment report stats, and receptionist book-on-behalf endpoint
Build Staff Console screen (doctor management, add doctor form, weekly availability editor, patient lookup and book for patient, report cards) with role-based visibility
End-to-end testing of core flows, load test at 200 concurrent users, accessibility check, security review and deployment with backups and encryption at rest

risks: Double-booking under concurrent load if slot reservation is not enforced with database transactions and unique constraints.
HIPAA/GDPR, audit log retention and encryption requirements could expand scope beyond MVP timeline.
Twilio SMS and SMTP delivery issues, approval delays or costs could delay reminders and delivery status features.
Meeting 99.9% uptime and 200-concurrent-user performance targets may need infrastructure effort beyond a small team's capacity.
Wide scope of five features and a staff console may slip; defer medium-priority F4 and F5 extras if time runs short.
